card.name: Digits inside long ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit partway through a long reference number such as a PubMed ID, PMID, ISBN, DOI or trial NCT number. It is strongest on the digit just before the last few digits.

modes.description: A digit in the middle of a PubMed, PMID, ISBN or DOI number in a reference list.
